poolBasis: The 18 named entries in the official 2021-09-15 pool announcement. The complete current server pool is not publicly verifiable; this content binds those names to explicit registered editions.
engineContracts: The owner chooses from three distinct sampled IDs; no query resamples them.
Each actor-owner-skill-binding has one use per exact Play phase.
HP loss is paid before choice and survives dying children without repetition.
A dead recipient or a departed originating phase receives no grant.
Permanent and other-source copies survive independent phase-source expiry.
Already owned skills remain in the declared pool; acquiring another source shares the existing runtime instance and quota.
A lost or dead skill owner cancels unpaid remaining instructions through the shared program continuation policy.
